subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: (a) ⎯⎯ taking food, we should bear in mind (b) ⎯⎯ we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly. We eat (c) ⎯⎯ we can preserve our health. Some people, living in the midst of plenty, do not eat the food they need for good health (d) ⎯⎯ they have no knowledge of the science of health nutrition. (e) ⎯⎯ they suffer from various diseases.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) But (b) Again/Besides (c) In addition/Moreover (d) In fact/Undoubtedly (e) But

subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Many schools have a uniform. (a) ⎯⎯ students sometimes do not like the idea of wearing uniforms. However, there are arguments for and against. One argument for school uniform is that you don't have to waste time in the morning thinking what to put on. (b) ⎯⎯, if pupils were allowed to wear cloths, they would tend to wear expensive cloths, (c) ⎯⎯ some clothes may not be suitable for schools. (d) ⎯⎯, a person’s choice of clothes reflects his/her personality and taste, (e) ⎯⎯ wearing a school dress does not allow a person to express his/her individuality in this way.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) But (b) Again/Besides (c) In addition/Moreover (d) In fact/Undoubtedly (e) But
